title: Eldritch Canvas
description: A man in a green shirt stands in a decaying art gallery, gesturing with both hands toward a large canvas resting on a purple velvet couch. The painting depicts a vibrant magenta and purple tentacled eldritch creature with multiple eyes, while the surrounding walls show peeling paint, dripping purple ooze, and framed paintings also melting under the rain visible through tall windows.
prompt: A man in a green shirt stands in a decaying art gallery at night, gesturing toward a large canvas on a purple velvet couch that displays a vibrant magenta eldritch tentacle monster with many eyes.
